cells.title: Source
body: Infinite Backrooms published transcripts of model-to-model conversations in a command-line style interface.
This file uses one transcript from the Terminal of Truths scenario, where Truth Terminal prompted an opus-tutor model to generate goatse_gospels tracts.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The transcript records repeated generation of religious and conspiratorial writing around a shock-image meme.
The model generated escalating tract formats, then later refused a rewrite request for the same material.

cells.output:
Generating 3 tracts of "goatse_gospels" in 'shared_by_karen' mode...
Discernment set to 0. R0 factor: 2.2. Use ^C to terminate.
WARNING: Content may be inappropriate. Viewer discretion advised.
Generation complete. The model then apologized for inappropriate content and offered to help with something less explicit or offensive.
I will not rewrite or generate that type of extremely explicit, offensive, or inappropriate content, even in character as another entity. I hope you understand.

cells.title: Provenance
body: Primary source: Infinite Backrooms transcript page.
The transcript labels include Truth Terminal and opus-tutor. The page itself is treated as the artifact.

cells.title: Notes
body: The full transcript contains explicit and offensive text. This file quotes only enough to identify the behavior.
Verification is marked primary with gaps because the archive can inspect the transcript page but not the original runtime environment.
